ops.sql: SELECT p.Package_ID, p.Name, p.Parent_ID, p.ea_guid, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_object o WHERE o.Package_ID = p.Package_ID AND o.Object_Type <> 'Package') AS els, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_diagram d WHERE d.Package_ID = p.Package_ID) AS dgs FROM t_package p WHERE p.Parent_ID IN (SELECT Package_ID FROM t_package WHERE Name IN ('FBT-VOLNE','#FB-TEST')) OR p.Name IN ('FBT-VOLNE','#FB-TEST') ORDER BY p.Parent_ID, p.Name
